name: Stacked panels
look: The section holds for one screen of scroll (two with four or five panels) under its h2, which stays on screen; each next panel slides up over the last, and the ones under it step back 4% each and fade toward the ground, their top edges a 14px stack.
reduced: Nothing is held: the panels stand one under another, each with its words and its picture.
phone: Nothing is held under 900px: the panels stand one under another, the picture under the words.

needs.words: 2 to 5 panels (plans, principles, cases), a title and two lines each
needs.pictures: one picture or screen per panel, or none
